tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Every outline, the eyes, all clean type on Paper. Never changes between grounds on the mascot.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Default video ground, the belly screen, key caps and UI panels.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Alternate video ground for menus, dark game scenes and end cards.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: MeowDude's body, hands and tail tip. Reserved for the mascot and logo; never used for text or UI.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Emphasis: highlighter swipes behind the one key word, the hype screen. One marker moment per frame.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: 'Do this': interactive UI, the correct choice, ticks, the pointing screen. Use as a fill with an ink outline, never as text.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: 'Don't do this': crosses, warnings, the oops screen. Use as a fill or a 9px stroke, never as body text.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The frame background. Flat, edge to edge, no vignette.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Instructions, labels and handwritten notes on the ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Annotation strokes (arrows, circles, underlines) drawn on the ground. Props and the mascot keep ink outlines.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on reference pages and production docs only. Not used in video frames.

styles.name: instruction
styles.usage: The one bold instruction per beat. Max six words. Archivo ExtraBold at 112% width.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Names of UI elements, stats, item names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Supporting fact under an instruction. Optional; skip if the voice-over covers it.

styles.name: keyglyph
styles.usage: The letter or symbol inside a key cap or pad button.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Annotations next to arrows and circles. Lowercase, two to four words.

styles.name: aside
styles.usage: Jokes and asides from MeowDude. Smaller, slightly rotated (-4 to 4 deg).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an annotation and the thing it labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside key caps and callout tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the instruction and its supporting element.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Title-safe margin on a 1920x1080 frame. Nothing readable sits outside it.

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: MeowDude's belly screen and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Key caps.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Simplified game UI panels.

stroke.note: Line weights at the mascot's base size (330px tall). Scale the whole drawing, never single strokes.

tokens.name: stroke-body
tokens.usage: The mascot silhouette outline, limbs and tail.

tokens.name: stroke-detail
tokens.usage: Screen, mouth, ear crease, hands, props and annotation lines.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Tick and cross marks.
